;Armed conflicts and attacks

**In the early hours of the morning, the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] hands over control of [[Al-Thawrah|Tabqa]], and the nearby [[List of Syrian Air Force bases|Tabqa Airbase]] in the [[Raqqa Governorate]] to the [[Syrian Army]]. *[[Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**A French tourist is stabbed to death while a Tunisian soldier is wounded by an [[Islamist]] in [[Bizerte]], [[Tunisia]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/14/c_138471373.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**Fourteen state police officers are killed in an ambush in [[Aguililla]], [[Michoacán]]; crime-scene evidence points to the involvement of the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50049142 (BBC News)] [https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/atacan-convoy-de-la-policia-estatal-en-michoacan-reportan-tres-muertos ''(El Universal)'']

;Arts and culture
*A stone statue is discovered in the walls of a church in England. Officials believe the statue had been hidden inside those walls for about 400 years since the [[Restoration (1660)|Restoration period]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/science/statue-hidden-in-churchs-wall-for-400-years-discovered/vi-AAILGKF (MSN)] [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-7571223/Statue-hidden-stone-mason-ordered-destroy-Restoration-uncovered.html (''Daily Mail'')]

;Business and economy
*The [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] selects [[Abhijit Banerjee]], [[Esther Duflo]] and [[Michael Kremer]] as laureates for this year's [[Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences|Nobel Prize in Economics]], "for their experimental approach to [[Poverty reduction|alleviating]] global [[poverty]]". [https://www.npr.org/2019/10/14/770004647/3-win-nobel-prize-in-economic-sciences-for-work-in-reducing-poverty (NPR)]

;Law and crime
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]], [[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Spain]] sentences the twelve Catalan independence leaders between 9 and 13 years in prison and disqualification from holding public office for sedition and misuse of public funds. While it proves the existence of violent outbreaks, it judges they are not sufficient to convict for rebellion. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49974289 (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/14/world/europe/catalonia-separatists-verdict-spain.html (''The New York Times'')]
**Former [[List of vice presidents of Catalonia|Catalan Vice President]] [[Oriol Junqueras]] receives the highest penalty with 13 years in prison and disqualification, while former councilors [[Meritxell Borràs]], [[Santi Vila]] and [[Carles Mundó]] are sentenced to one year and eight months disqualification for disobedience. [https://elpais.com/politica/2019/10/14/actualidad/1571033446_440448.html (''El País'')]
**Demonstrations and cut roads take place throughout Catalonia, with the largest taking place in Barcelona. The [[Committees for the Defense of the Republic]] calls for disobedience and popular revolt. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20191014/mapa-carreteras-cortadas-manifestaciones-sentencia-proces-7677209 (''El Periódico'')] [https://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2019/10/14/5da407d321efa0a1248b468a.html (''El Mundo'')]
**[[President of Catalonia]] [[Quim Torra]] requests a meeting with [[King of Spain|King]] [[Felipe VI]] of Spain and [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] and calls the sentence as an act of "revenge". Sánchez, in a special press conference, guarantees compliance with the sentence and calls for dialogue and coexistence, as well as ensures that Spain is a democratic state. [https://www.elconfidencial.com/multimedia/video/espana/cataluna/2019-10-14/quim-torra-sentencia-proces-tribunal-supremo_2281643/ (''El Confidencial'')] [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2019/10/14/5da4340121efa0a21a8b45a1.html (''El Mundo'')]
**Judge Pablo Llarena issues a [[European Arrest Warrant]] against former Catalan President [[Carles Puigdemont]]. [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2019/10/14/5da4623221efa0752d8b468a.html (''El Confidencial'')] 
**Clashes erupts between [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] and the protesters that occupied the [[Barcelona–El Prat Josep Tarradellas Airport]]. Several flights are cancelled. [https://www.abc.es/espana/catalunya/abci-tsunami-democratic-convoca-independentismo-ocupar-aeropuerto-barcelona-201910141305_noticia.html (''ABC.es'')]
*Convicted [[United Kingdom|British]] serial sex offender and paedophile [[Richard Huckle]], who sexually abused dozens of children in [[Malaysia]], is found stabbed to death in his cell at [[HM Prison Full Sutton]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50042406 (BBC News)]
*The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC]] say they captured [[Ruhollah Zam]], an [[Iran]]ian journalist-activist exiled in Europe, accusing him of having stoked anti-government [[2017–18 Iranian protests|unrest in early 2018]] using social media. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-opposition-arrest/iran-says-it-captures-exiled-journalist-who-supported-2018-unrest-idUSKBN1WT1JT (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Westminster car attack]]
**At the [[Old Bailey]] in [[London]], Salih Khater is sentenced to [[life imprisonment  in the United Kingdom|life imprisonment]] with a minimum term of fifteen years. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-50044250 (BBC News)]
*[[Shooting of Atatiana Jefferson]]
**Aaron Dean, the [[Fort Worth, Texas]] police officer who shot a woman to death in her bedroom during what was intended to be a welfare check, resigns his position, and later that day is arrested and formally charged with murder in the case. [https://www.foxnews.com/us/fort-worth-police-officer-in-shooting-investigation (Fox News)]
